title: System Package
description: packages.system in an instance file: one installation.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: What a developer sees while working on the installation. On by default on DEV, off everywhere else.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: The debug output and the debug tool. Render time and script time only work while it is on.

render.title: Render time
render.description: Records which template and panel rendered each part of the page, for the layer trees of the debug tool. Costs time on every request.

time.title: Script time
time.description: Defines DEBUGTIME. Nothing in the packages reads it at the moment.

displayErrors.title: Display PHP errors
displayErrors.description: PHP shows its errors in the page (display_errors). Errors are logged either way. Independent of Debug.

versionAppendix.title: Version appendix
versionAppendix.description: Appended to asset URLs, so browsers load a new version. time: the current time, every request a new one. Not set: versionDate.

versionDate.title: Version date
versionDate.description: The release the installation runs, appended to asset URLs when no version appendix is set. Empty: nothing is appended.

linkSites.title: Link sites
linkSites.description: Create the links of the sites in public/, so every site answers under its own path on this machine. A DEV convenience.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: How scripts and styles of the packages reach the browser. source: straight from their folders. serve: through /assets/, from the originals every time. publish: through /assets/, copied to public/assets/. Not set: the originals where the web reaches them, copies where it does not.

sysPath.title: System path
sysPath.description: Where the system package lies, relative to the project folder.

mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Without an account, DEV hands the mail to Mailpit and every other stage refuses to send.

host.title: SMTP host
host.description: The server mail is handed to. Empty on DEV: the local mail catcher (127.0.0.1:1025).

secure.title: Encryption
secure.description: tls: STARTTLS on the port, ssl: encrypted from the start, none: plain text.

user.title: User
user.description: The account name at the SMTP host. The password lies in config.local.json of the machine.

from.title: From address
from.description: The sender of every mail. The SMTP host has to allow it.

fromName.title: From name
fromName.description: The name shown with the from address.

testMode.title: Test mode
testMode.description: Every To, CC and BCC goes to the test recipient instead. DEV always routes like this, even when the switch is off: it is for LIVE and STAGING.

testRecipient.title: Test recipient
testRecipient.description: Where test routing sends every mail. Empty: testmail@fluxo.systems. An invalid address blocks delivery.
